title: Correct MSCDEX inventory for AX=150C version and AX=1510 device request semantics
description: Runtime replay with a configured D: drive passes AX=1500 and AX=150C, then reaches AX=1510 at EIP 0x001D23A7 with a 26-byte device-driver initialization packet. The existing reports/LOCAL_MSCDEX_INVENTORY.md mislabels 150C as TOC and 1510 as drive contents. Verify dynamic request frames and static callsites against RBIL/device-driver ABI, correct inventory and create a WORK2 follow-up for the precise 1510 behavior needed. Preserve original reference media read-only.
acceptance: Correct AX=150C and AX=1510 names/semantics in the MSCDEX inventory and related queue-derived report
Classify exact 1510 command code and required response fields from request packet at evidence/mscdex_driver_request_work2.json
Distinguish services measured before MENU from static/post-MENU callsites; do not describe 150C as TOC or 1510 as ISO directory listing
Create a narrowly scoped Runtime follow-up for any remaining measured 1510 behavior
